memberaccess-auth-resend-throttled: Koodhadh aad u badan ayaa la codsaday. Isticmaal koodhkii hore loo soo diray.

memberaccess-auth-email-missing: Geli cinwaankaaga iimaylka si aad u hesho koodhka soo gelitaanka.
memberaccess-auth-email-invalid: Geli cinwaan iimayl oo sax ah.
memberaccess-auth-throttled: Koodhadh soo gelitaan oo aad u badan ayaa la codsaday. Mar kale isku day goor dambe.

memberaccess-auth-code-help: Koodhka soo gelitaanka ee lixda lambar ka kooban.
memberaccess-auth-code-wrong: Koodhkaasi sax ma aha. Waxaa kuu haray $2 {{PLURAL:$2|isku day|isku dayo}} si aad u geliso koodhka loo diray $1.
memberaccess-auth-code-missing: Geli koodhka soo gelitaanka ee iimaylka laguugu soo diray.
memberaccess-auth-code-outstanding: Geli koodhka soo gelitaanka ee loo diray $1.
memberaccess-auth-code-expired: Koodhkaas mar dambe lama isticmaali karo. Codso koodh cusub.
memberaccess-auth-not-authorized: Cinwaankan laguma soo geli karo halkan.
memberaccess-auth-failed: Soo gelitaanku ma dhammaan. Codso koodh cusub oo soo gelitaan ah; haddii dhibaatadani sii socoto, la xiriir maamulaha wiki-gan.
memberaccess-auth-password-refused: Xubnuhu waxay ku soo galaan koodh hal mar ah, sidaas darteed akoonkani ma yeelan karo furaha sirta ah.
